notes: Stated as an endless runner, so Infinite Runner and its genre-wide P6, which the endless track needs anyway for speed-derived obstacle spacing. Temple Run is the named reference but the prompt overrides its steering with three lanes and a swipe to switch between them, which is the lane-snap fork, so Lane Runner is the preset with its own shape and all three of its options intact. Added hazard-kill because the answer makes contact with an obstacle the thing that ends the run, and obstacle-jump because the Temple Run vocabulary the prompt invokes includes gaps and hurdles as well as lane blockers. Without a user I decided the jungle temple is a themed skin on the chunk queue rather than distinct biome maps, so no P4, and I took the answer's instruction to keep the Zootopia influence to bright stylized art direction with no anthropomorphic characters or signage.
